result.title: Learning Pseudo-Riemannian Manifolds for Heterophilic Graphs via Graph Signature
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 41 pages, including appendix
result.summary: Several widely used families of Graph Neural Networks carry a positive-definite geometric prior. Graph convolution read as heat diffusion needs a positive semi-definite operator, hyperbolic models place features on positive-definite Riemannian manifolds, and dot-product and GAT-style attention scores use positive-definite inner products. On heterophilic graphs, where edges often signify dissimilarity or structural repulsion, that prior is a mismatch: no positive-definite form can assign a negative squared distance to a direction the labels separate. To measure the mismatch, we introduce the Graph Signature Index ($s_{\mathcal{G}}$), the inertia of a class-compatibility matrix built from label topology alone, and we prove that no value of the edge or node homophily index in $(0,1)$ rules out a negative eigenvalue. We then propose the Pseudo-Riemannian Attention Network (PRAT), whose attention logit is a signed squared pseudo-distance under a learnable diagonal metric initialized from $s_{\mathcal{G}}$. The design is diagnose-then-learn: the signature supplies a sign structure that unconstrained training keeps outside near-zero directions, and the projection learns the rest of the metric around it. Across fifteen node-classification benchmarks PRAT outperforms or matches the strongest heterophily-adapted models. A controlled ablation ties that performance to the sign structure itself: with architecture and protocol fixed, forbidding the metric to be indefinite costs accuracy on the graphs $s_{\mathcal{G}}$ marks as indefinite and leaves the others unchanged.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对异质图（边表示相异或结构排斥）中正定几何先验不匹配的问题，提出 Graph Signature Index 来量化类兼容矩阵的惯性，并据此设计 PRAT：以符号化的伪距离平方作为注意力 logit，在学习到的对角度量下进行训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用不定度量表示相异/排斥关系」及「先诊断矩阵惯性、再约束学习」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的表示几何（尤其相似度是否需带符号结构、状态是否需编码反差信息）提供可核查的类比工具，但领域相距较远，需要较多迁移工作。
